title: Institutional Policy is the live policy authority
summary: AccessPermissionsPolicyResolver resolves either one sealed fixed Access Control/Permission policy or a policy id through InstitutionalPolicyCatalog at an exact authorization time, optionally using resolveForContext for deployment-scoped selection.
invariants: Resolver kind is fixed as ACCESS_CONTROL or PERMISSION.
Catalog resolution grants no authority by itself; it supplies the operative policy object.
Suspended, withdrawn, ineffective, unavailable, wrong-id, wrong-kind, or unsealed policy resolution fails closed.
Fixed-policy v0.2 construction remains compatible through internally wrapped fixed resolvers.

provenance.claim: v0.3 adds fixed or Institutional Policy catalog resolution and deliberately gives Access Control and Permission different lifecycle behavior.
AccessPermissionsPolicyResolver supports sealed fixed policy or live catalog resolution, optional deployment context, and fail-closed protocol/id/kind/effectiveness checks.
